strings.Downloads every video and photo of this: Downloads every video and photo of this profile with your browser's own sign-in. It scrolls this tab slowly, a screen every few seconds like a person, and only reads what the page shows: nothing is liked, followed or posted, and Nexonic never sees your password. Stop ends it at any time.
